content:
Join Mania Casino and discover a world of casino entertainment! Spin popular slots, play with live dealers, explore crash games or place bets on sporting events. We have brought everything together in one place, so you can easily switch between your favourite games and discover something new.

At Mania, you can enjoy quick registration, welcome bonuses, regular promotions and our loyalty programme, The Godfather's Lounge. Open lootboxes, collect rewards, climb the VIP ranks and get assistance from our 24/7 support team. Get started in just a few simple steps and choose the games you enjoy most.

Online Slots

Love classic reels, exciting bonus rounds or slots with changing winning combinations? At Mania Casino, you can explore games with different mechanics, themes and features. Choose familiar favourites or discover new adventures where every spin brings a different result.

Start with Gates of Olympus by Pragmatic Play, where cascading wins combine with multipliers that can affect your final payout. Sweet Bonanza replaces traditional paylines with clusters of matching symbols, while Big Bass Bonanza takes you on a fishing adventure with bonus spins and opportunities to collect cash symbols.

If you enjoy unusual game mechanics, try Buffalo King Megaways or The Dog House Megaways. The number of ways to form winning combinations changes with each spin. For a different atmosphere, explore Wanted Dead or a Wild with its Wild West theme, or enter the mystical world of Madame Destiny Megaways.

At Mania, you can also explore themed slot collections. Megaways brings together games featuring the popular mechanic, Ancient Egypt takes you on adventures through the world of the pharaohs, while Halloween adds a spooky atmosphere. Before you start playing, open the game rules to learn about available stakes, winning combinations and bonus features.

Live Casino Games

Want to experience the atmosphere of a real casino table? Visit Live Casino at Mania and join rounds hosted by real dealers. Place your bets, follow the action in real time and see the result as each round comes to an end.

Play Diamond VIP Roulette, Galaxy Roulette or Turkish Roulette by SevenMojos Live. Choose your table, set your stake and watch the ball travel around the roulette wheel. If you prefer an automated experience, try Gold Club Auto Roulette, where the wheel spins without a live dealer.

Card game enthusiasts can enjoy Dragon Tiger, Teen Patti Face Off or Andar Bahar. In Dragon Tiger, the outcome depends on comparing two cards. Teen Patti Face Off uses card combinations, while Andar Bahar challenges you to predict which side will receive a card matching the chosen rank. Each game has its own rules and betting options, so at Mania Casino you can choose the experience that best suits your preferences.

Crash Games

Try crash games at Mania Casino if you enjoy quick rounds where every second can change the outcome. A typical round begins with a multiplier that gradually increases. You decide when to cash out and lock in the current value. If the round ends before you cash out, your stake is lost.

Unlike traditional slots, crash games involve deciding when to cash out. There is no need to wait for a series of spins to finish, as a round can end at any moment. Rules and multiplier mechanics vary between games. Remember that a rising multiplier does not guarantee a win, and previous results cannot predict what will happen next.

Sports Betting

Follow sporting events with Mania and place bets on the competitions that interest you. Our sportsbook covers football, basketball, tennis, volleyball and table tennis. Esports fans can also explore betting opportunities on competitive video gaming events.

In football, you can explore markets covering match results, total goals and other outcomes. Basketball bets may focus on total points, while tennis and volleyball markets can depend on individual sets or the overall match result. The specific betting markets and odds depend on the event you choose.

To place a bet at Mania Casino, select a sporting event and your preferred outcome. Your bet slip will then display the odds, stake and potential payout. Check the details before confirming your selection. Bets are settled according to the official results of sporting events.

Sports bonuses have separate conditions. Qualifying bets must have minimum odds of 2.0, and these bonus funds can only be used in the sportsbook. They cannot be used on slots or live dealer games.

Mania VIP Club

Join The Godfather's Lounge and unlock new privileges with Mania Casino. Our loyalty programme lets you gradually progress through the ranks based on account activity and gameplay. To start participating, you need to make at least one deposit. Once you have joined, you can earn progress towards higher levels.

The VIP Club features five ranks: Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum and Diamond. Start at Bronze and work your way towards Diamond, unlocking additional rewards as you progress. Your advancement depends on gaming activity, while the benefits available to you change according to your VIP status.

Mania offers club members weekly Reload bonuses, improved lootboxes, cashback and personalised deposit offers. The programme also includes exclusive VIP bonuses, special raffles, a personal VIP manager and a dedicated 24/7 support line. Eligible members may also benefit from increased withdrawal limits, priority withdrawal processing and higher permitted stakes when using bonuses.

Each reward has its own eligibility conditions. For example, cashback is reserved for VIP members, while personalised benefits become available according to your status. Follow your progress in The Godfather's Lounge to see your current level and discover which rewards you can unlock next.

Bonuses and Promotions

At Mania Casino, we have prepared bonuses for different types of gameplay. New members can enjoy welcome packages for slots or sports betting, while returning players can explore regular promotions and special offers. Choose a bonus that matches your gaming preferences and familiarise yourself with its conditions.

Our slots welcome offer provides 777% up to €8,000. If sports betting is more your style, you can choose a welcome package of 335% up to €3,000. For further deposits, we have Weekly Offers featuring 550% up to €8,000 for slots, while Sport Daily Reload provides 700% up to €17,500 for sports betting.

VIP Club members can access additional rewards. The exclusive slots package offers 1350% up to €61,000. Mania also runs themed promotions, including Halloween Offers with a bonus package of 2990% up to 70,000 in the currency specified by the promotion. Seasonal offers are available during their respective promotional periods.

Each bonus comes with its own activation and usage rules. At Mania Casino, only one bonus can be active at a time. The maximum permitted stake when using bonus funds is €2 or the equivalent in another currency. Certain slots and game categories are excluded from play with active slots bonuses. Purchasing or activating in-game bonus features while a bonus is active is also prohibited.

Promotional conditions may include restrictions on eligible games, stake sizes and maximum payouts. Some offers have additional rules covering funds received through the promotion. You can check the full details of each bonus before activating it.

Lootboxes

Open chests at Mania and discover what surprises await! Lootboxes add another way to collect rewards alongside your favourite casino games. Inside, you may find bonus coins, boosters, special prizes and XP linked to your loyalty programme progress.

At Mania Casino, you can choose from Bronze Chest for 50 Coins, Silver Chest for 100 Coins and Gold Chest for 400 Coins. Each chest has its own price in internal coins and belongs to a different category. You need the required number of Coins in your balance to open a chest.

Choose your chest, start the spin and reveal your reward. Once the process is complete, you will see which prize you have received. The contents depend on the chest type and reward mechanics, so each opening may bring a different result.

Lootboxes are also connected to The Godfather's Lounge. As you progress through the VIP ranks, improved chests and additional features may become available. The rules for collecting Coins, using XP and accessing rewards are determined by the relevant conditions.

How to Register

You can create an account at Mania Casino in less than a minute. Click the registration button, enter the required personal information and confirm your account creation. Registration details include your name, telephone number, email address, username and password. All information must be accurate and belong to the account holder.

Our casino is intended for adults who meet the applicable eligibility requirements for gambling. Each member may create their own account, which cannot be transferred or sold to another person.

Once registration is complete, sign in to Mania using your account credentials. If you forget your password, use the password recovery feature. We will never ask for your password through customer support. Keep your login details secure and contact us if you notice any suspicious activity on your account.

Deposits and Withdrawals

Top up your Mania Casino balance and manage withdrawals through your account cashier. Financial transactions can be made using supported payment methods, including bank cards and cryptocurrency transfers. Before confirming a transaction, you can check its payment details and conditions. Funds are credited to your gaming balance once the deposit has been processed.

Only use payment methods that belong to you when depositing at Mania. If you make a payment by bank card, the card details must belong to the account holder. For cryptocurrency transfers, always use the current wallet details, as entering an incorrect address may result in lost funds. Deposit limits are determined by the conditions of the relevant transaction.

The minimum withdrawal amount at Mania Casino is €100. The standard daily limit is €1,000, while the weekly limit is €2,000. Under our cashier rules, you can submit one withdrawal request within a 24-hour period. Members with eligible VIP status may benefit from higher limits and priority withdrawal processing.

Before withdrawing funds, you must meet the applicable deposit usage conditions and ensure your balance does not include amounts that are unavailable for withdrawal. In particular, the total value of bets placed must be at least equal to your most recent deposit. Funds tied to unfinished games or bonus amounts that do not yet meet withdrawal conditions cannot be withdrawn.

To help protect financial transactions, Mania uses Know Your Customer (KYC) verification. This is required when requesting a withdrawal, after cumulative deposits exceed €2,000 or when additional checks are necessary. We may request proof of identity, a selfie holding your identification document, proof of address and confirmation of your payment method. In certain circumstances, documents confirming the source of funds may also be required.

We process withdrawal requests according to our established procedures and payment provider requirements. Completion of a transaction depends on the outcome of the necessary checks and the accuracy of your payment details. If you have any questions about a transaction, our customer support team is available around the clock.

Mobile Casino

Play at Mania Casino on your smartphone and enjoy your favourite games beyond your desktop computer. We support mobile gaming through your browser and our app, allowing you to open slots, join Live Casino tables, explore crash games and access sports betting from your mobile device.

With the mobile version of Mania, you can sign in to your account, explore available bonuses and manage your balance. Choose a game, switch between categories and use our casino features without needing a desktop computer.

For another way to access our casino, you can use the mobile app. Installation and compatibility depend on the version available for your operating system. Only install the app through the options provided on our website to avoid unverified third-party files.

Responsible Gaming

At Mania Casino, we support responsible gambling. Playing should remain a form of entertainment rather than a source of income or a solution to financial difficulties. Every bet carries the risk of losing money, so it is important to set personal limits in advance and stick to them.

We provide tools for setting limits on deposits, stakes, losses and gaming session duration. Deposit and betting limits can apply for periods ranging from 24 hours to one week. You can also access your transaction history through your account to keep track of your spending and activity.

If you need a break, you can activate a Cool-down period lasting from 1 to 48 hours. During this time, new deposits, betting and gameplay are suspended. For longer breaks, Mania provides a self-exclusion option. This suspends access to your account and stops promotional communications. Requests must be submitted through the designated customer support procedure.

Never use borrowed money for gambling or try to recover losses by placing more bets. If gambling starts to affect your mood, finances or everyday life, support is available from organisations such as Gambling Therapy and Gamblers Anonymous. At Mania, our casino entertainment is intended exclusively for adults.

mainEntity.name: Can I play at Mania Casino without making a deposit?

acceptedAnswer.text: You need to deposit funds to place real-money bets. The option to explore individual games without wagering real money depends on the features of the specific game.

mainEntity.name: How can I check how much XP I need to reach the next VIP level?

acceptedAnswer.text: Open The Godfather's Lounge in your account. There, you can follow your loyalty programme progress and view information about available ranks and benefits.

mainEntity.name: Can I use a sports bonus on slots?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Sports bonuses are intended exclusively for betting on sporting events. Using these funds in other game categories violates the promotion's conditions.

mainEntity.name: What happens to my bonus if I request a withdrawal?

acceptedAnswer.text: If the bonus conditions have not yet been fulfilled, an early withdrawal request may result in the cancellation of the bonus and any associated winnings. The final outcome depends on the rules of the relevant promotion.

mainEntity.name: Can I change an existing deposit limit?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can reduce your deposit limit while it is active. Increases are not permitted until the current restriction period has ended.

mainEntity.name: How can I report a problem with a game result?

acceptedAnswer.text: Contact our customer support team and explain the issue, including the relevant details of your gaming session. Disputes concerning game results must be submitted within 7 calendar days. We handle these enquiries according to our established dispute resolution procedure.
